balls.text: Bouncer. Pulled off the front foot. Top edge. Taken by the keeper
Lovely yorker, absolutely nothing Badri can do with this apart from taking the single
Anirudha moves across for the scoop over short fine, and he gets beaten by moving inside the line of a delivery wide outside off! Go figure
slower ball, early into the shot, gets a single to fine leg
Beautiful shot! Length ball, stays back, clears the front leg, and lofts it over mid-off. Holds the pose with the high elbow
Lovely bouncer to start off with, 138ks, beats Badri's attempt at the pull
gets the yorker right this time, but some sharp running gets them a couple to long-on
near yorker, lofted over Thomas's head, comes back for two
sets himself up for the big heave-ho over midwicket, but all he manages is an inside edge onto the pads. Takes the single, though

second drop of the night for Yuvraj, second really difficult chance too, this time he dives to his wrong side, right, at extra cover, and again manages to touch it but can't keep it. Single taken. Harsh to call it a drop?
yorker, on the crease, around off, hit back to Thomas
Badri comes down the track and hits this short delivery to long-on
slower ball, bowled from behind the umpire, Anirduha nicely clips it fine off the pads and comes back for two
short, sharp, following the backing-away Badri, who tips and runs

Morkel, promoted ahead of specialist batsman Badri who scored 71 in his last game, is out for a four-ball duck. He throws his bat at this widish delivery without any foot movement, and gets a thick edge that settles peacefully with deep cover
bouncer, sharp one too, but deemed a wide for height
third straight dot for Morkel as he looks to pull this but hits it back to Taylor

Welcome back Pandey! One of his first touches on the ball this IPL! And what a catch. Hussey plays the shovel shot, but doesn't get it right off the middle, and it flies towards long-on. Pandey stations himself six inches inside the fence, and takes the overhead catch. Was always aware of the fence. Welcome back Manish. Well played Hussey too, as he doesn't hand about and takes Pandey's word on it
lovely chip shot by Hussey. Comes forward, and lofts this almost on the run, over extra cover. Could have been a slower delivery, but adjusts really well
another dot, quick legbreak that turns in just a bit, and thuds into his pad
full and quick, turned away to midwicket

The luck has run out! And it is very well bowled too. Flights the next delivery after being smacked for a straight boundary. Dhoni is beaten in the flight, and the ball turns past his bat, and Uthappa is very quick with the stumping
No luck involved here! A little shimmy down the track, and murders this over Rahul's head, hitting the boundary rope on the half-volley
More luck! Dhoni looks to slog this to Pondicherry, but is early into the shot, and the thick inside edge finds the fine-leg fence
looks to pull, but the ball hurries onto him, and the top edge falls safe towards mid-on
charges down the track, but drives it straight towards sweeper-cover
digs out a yorker to take another single
shovels this length delivery to deep midwicket
slower ball, Dhoni aborts the down-the-ground shot, and takes a single to deep point
another full toss, but hits it straight to deep midwicket, and gets just the single
wide down the leg side
and Hussey opens up, driving this low full toss past extra cover, all along the ground. Brings up his fifty too
googly, Hussey watches it nicely and opens the face to take a single
punched to point for a single
this one is hit straight to deep midwicket, and will yield just the single
quick running, this is placed nicely between the two deep fielders on the on side, and they come back for two
another edged boundary for Hussey! Yorker outside off, and it takes the outside edge off the bottom quarter of the bat, and past short third man
looks to force this into the leg side, gets a single off the inside half of the bat
arm ball, Dhoni stays back and pushes it past cover
back to ones, working this into the leg side

Hussey has had enough of those singles, and looks to pull this one. It doesn't quite come on, takes the inside edge onto the pad and lobs down the pitch. Uthappa wants the catch but finds Hussey in his way. Hussey is not out of line, though
pushed away past cover for one
turns and grips, Dhoni plays it back uppishly to the bowler
Hussey is still working the singles, to deep midwicket this time
Yuvraj saw something similar in Mumbai from the non-striker's end in the WC final. This time he is bowling, and Dhoni smoothly, casually, lofts him into the sight screen. Move on finally?
there we go again, Hussey takes a single to deep square now
near-yorker, digs it out for a single to long-off
Hussey is as if he is on a dating site, picking singles every ball without any fuss. This time to point
Jissy! Low full toss hit hard, and Ryder saves three with a dive at midwicket
chips down the track, takes another single
another single turned around the corner by Hussey. He is like a single-taking robot right now
Thomas has taken two wickets in his last over, and has saved a run with his dive at deep point
Turn, sharp, angled into off, then pitching and breaking away, but misses both the edge and the off stump
into the pads, played back to Kartik, well in front of the body
full around off, defended back to him
and another single taken off the pads
Nearly! The arm ball, and Dhoni has no clue about it, but he manages to bring his bat down in time to save that off stump
full, on the pads, clipped to deep midwicket
flights this one up, Dhoni pushes it to point and steals the single
shorter, flatter, Dhoni cuts in front of square, but straight to cover
nicely tossed up, around off, Dhoni stretches forward and defends
worked away off the pads for a single

Cleaned up! You could sense Raina was not fancying this much. Backs away to a shortish delivery, looking for a shot through the covers, and plays completely down the wrong line. Middle and leg poles are down
inside edge onto the pad as he looks to force this shortish delivery into the leg side
And the bouncer duly arrives, and duly gets the top edge as Raina looks to hook it from outside off, but the op edge clears mid-off
No, just back of a length, angled across off, defended off the back foot
Finally they take a chance, do Pune! Sharp bouncer, between chest and throat, Vijay looks to pull off the front foot, but is slightly late, and the top edge lobs to midwicket
clipped off the pads for one
full on the pads, worked away for a single
quicker outside off, defended back to the bowler

Not only will Pune not hit water if thrown off a boat, they won't catch a cold either! Dropped by Yuvraj at extra cover. Slightly harsh to call it a drop because Yuvraj did everything right as he leapt for this overhead chance. Six inches lower and it would have settled in as opposed to hitting just the fingers
driven past extra cover, nice shot, and they take two by the time long-off comes around
Hussey is beaten in the flight again, gets hit in the pad, and sends Vijay back
another shimmy down the track for a single to long-off
chips down the wicket and chips this over cover for one
short ball, and pulled away to deep backward square
slower through the air, grips a little, around off, Hussey respects it
plays this in front of his body, pushes it to long-off for one

Lovely shot! Vijay is making those strokes of luck count here. Charges down the track, has enough distance off the pitch of the ball to give him room to swing, and lofts this over the sight screen. Clean
pulls this one off a length, hurried into the shot because it is not quite short enough, gets a single
another attempted cut off a delivery too full, nearly edges it
looks to cut but it's too full, and can't get it past point
pushed wide of point this time for a single
slider, gets an inside edge as Hussey looks to run it down, but can't find the stumps
And another run-out missed! This time Vijay is slow taking the single to short third, but the throw is wide, and Vijay has run between the bowler and stumps too
middle of the bat this time, and defended to point
And again! It's the outside edge this time, done in by the straighter delivery that takes the edge and goes past Uthappa. No slip there
more luck going Chennai's way as Hussey is beaten in the flight as he charges down the track. Just as Uthappa is contemplating a stumping, though, Hussey gets an inside edge that goes for four
full, on the pads, flicked wide of mid-on
turned wide of square leg for a single
on target, middle and off, no turn, defended
yorker, can't do much with it
good running, tips and runs, hardly went off the pitch
Ordinary from McCullum at extra cover as Hussey drives a low full toss towards him, but he dives over it. keeping up with general fielding standards of the tournament
beaten outside off off a fuller delivery. Taylor is bowling well here
Ripper! Lovely bouncer, throat high, and over stumps. Hussey can't do anything with it
steered down to third man for one

full toss on the pads, and Vijay says no thanks to the gift as he closes the bat too early. They steal a leg-bye, and this time Hussey is close to getting run out. Pune haven't hit the stumps today at all. Reminds me of a line from The Firm: "You won't be able to hit water if you were thrown off a boat..."
clipped away off the pads, past short fine, comes back for two more
slight movement in towards him as he looks to loft him over midwicket, beats him
defended to cover off a length
that's a Vijay special! Stands tall to a shortish ball, waiting for it, and swings it cleanly over midwicket
back off a length, clipped away off the pads, and comes back for two
and again Vijay is close to getting run out, taking a single to square leg from where Murali Kartik goes at Vijay's end. His bat gets stuck in the ground as he looks to slide it in, but is safe
nicely turned around the corner, with soft hands, ensuring enough time to come back for two before deep square leg can come in
flat on the pads, turned to midwicket
is looking to come down again, but sees a quick delivery and stays in the crease to drive it to sweeper-cover
quicker delivery, full defended with an open face
Whack! Hussey charges at McCullum, gets right to its pitch and lofts him over mid-off. Happy Anzac Day from an Aussie, Nathan

Vijay is living a charmed life here, as Taylor produces the edge that flies past the first and only slip. However, it must be said that Vijay played it with soft hands, and it wouldn't have carried to the second slip even if there was one
slower ball outside off, nearly yorks him as he his bat jams into the ground
it's not stopping Vijay from being aggressive with the running, though, as he plays this wide of deep square and charges back for the second
Vijay has survived two run-outs in two balls. He has flicked a full ball straight to short fine, and is half way down the wicket. Alfonso Thomas misses with the direct hit too
nearly a run-out, this is a slower ball, which Hussey tips and runs, but Ryder is deceptively quick to swoop on it from point. He misses with the direct hit, though. Vijay was a goner had he hit
full ball, angled across, beats the drive. Taylor is looking in decent rhythm
and what a comeback, wicked quick bouncer, slightly higher than the head, and called a wide
Hussey does the same, with an open face, and rushes through for a single
takes the single, just drops and runs
looks for the drive outside off, but hits it straight to cover and sends Hussey back
comes down the track to defend this, Test style
this one stops and bounces at Vijay, whose defensive prod is uppish for a moment but not long enough to bother him
starts on target, on middle and leg, and defended to midwicket
full and wide, played to point. All over
full, on the pads, single to fine leg
short, at his ribs, Thomas gets the short one too, fended away
low full toss, gets a single to long-on
Exclamation mark from an Aussie on Anzac Day. Dismissing a Kiwi. Quick, sharp bouncer, aimed at his jaw. McCullum hooks, gets a top edge that goes nowhere. Gone
hit to long-on, wants to come back for two, and Mukund is in action again. From long-on, he hits the stumps direct. Taylor has to go

Nearly another blinder! Taylor mis-hits this one, and Abhinav Mukund runs backwards from extra cover, and while doing so nearly pulls off a stunner overhead. But as he comes down, the impact and the jerk throw the ball out of his grip
sharp bouncer - giving some of his own medicine back to Taylor, but it is called a wide for height
slower bouncer, too good for McCullum, and Dhoni underarms this as they try to steal the bye. And Sharma is short of the crease
slower ball, gets an inside edge square on the on side

Jakati flies across at extra cover! Length ball outside off, on his day Yuvraj would have hit this for a six blindfolded. This hasn't been his day, though, and he has struggled for timing bar two beautiful straight drives. And this one hits the toe end, and is going towards straightish extra cover when Jakati comes flying across and intercepts it beautifully
mis-hit, over Morkel's head, Yuvraj shouts two from the off, and comes back comfortably even though they target his end
slogged away, but gets just the single to deep square. This was a length ball, and was there to be hit
good shot, crunchy drive through the covers, but can't beat sweeper-cover
back of a length, mis-hit down to long-on, just the single - another singe and it will come up to three runs required per ball
hit over cover, and short of sweeper-cover, gets a single, won't do for Pune
near yorker on leg stump, Yuvraj swings, gets the inside edge onto the pad, takes the single
quicker short ball, Yuvraj backs away and pulls, is beaten
slower ball, beats Yuvraj's attempt to run it down to third man. It's getting steeper and steeper
hit to the left of long-on, they come back for two. Yuvraj will be on strike
Dhoni has missed a stumping! Ashwin bowled short when he sw McCullum coming, the batsman missed, but Dhoni failed to collect the ball
clean hit this time, but on the bounce to long-off
Yuvraj seems to be struggling here, gets this to short fine, but falls over in the process, and makes no attempt to get back up and take a single
short delivery, cuts it, but can't find the gap between point and short third
opens the face, hands the strike over to Yuvraj

full toss, hit hard, but straight to Raina at midwicket. Not the greatest bit of cricket form both sides in this over. First Yuvraj not running the second, then Jakati not there to accept a throw. And then this full toss hit straight to Raina

another run-out opportunity goes. This time McCullum is not even in the frame after hitting it to point and running the single. The direct hit misses, but the bowler - a spinner mind you - is nowhere to accept the throw
poor running, Yuvraj has swept this fine... is he thinking it is four all the way? No, sir, Anirudha makes a diving save, and he is no position to come back for the second. He has lost the strike too
flat and quick, cut away for two, wide of deep point

Nearly got him. Yuraj seems lucky to have survived this one. He misses on the sweep on a really full delivery, which hits him on the back leg in front of middle and leg. No turn on this. Is this the luck Pune need? Umpire Tiffin made the call
NMac moves across, gets inside the line of this, and gets a single to midwicket
slower through the air, middle and leg line, goes with the arm, hits Yuvraj in the pads. Dot ball. "Goldust," says Robin Jackman
hit to extra cover, and Raina's direct hit gives them the overthrow
driven to long-on for one
full, into the pads, worked away for one
sharp turn and bounce, beats him as he looks to run this down to third man
Whoa! Nothing about this gentle push to long-on suggests it can be more than a single to long-on. However, the fielder at long-on finds out he has no chance of saving this one
diving save at extra cover, valuable dot ball here
short, on the pads, worked away between two deep fielders on the leg side, comes back for two
sees Yuvraj come down, bowls it quick and flat, Yuvraj manages just the leg-bye
flat and quick on the pads, played back to the bowler

lovely bit of timing, this is a flat delivery, and he has punched it from in front of off, past point. Equally good bit of fielding from substitute Abhinav Mukund who gives the chase and then dives to keep it inside
hit very very hard, on the bounce to deep midwicket
offcutter across him, beats the prod
Gone! Looks to run this down very very fine, very very late. Too cute! Gets a regulation edge, and Dhoni makes no mistake. On the replay, I see some extra bounce too. Well done Doug
full and wide of off, can't get there
full toss on the pads, gets just the single to deep square leg
runs this down to third man, and this time Morkel dives to save a couple
pulled to left of midwicket, Randiv does well at long-on to keep them down to one
angled across him, hit straight to extra cover where Raina is tigerish
runs this down to third man for another single
another well-timed shot, but he has hit his partner, Manhas, gets just the single
worked off the pads for a single
lovely chip shot, wide of extra cover, and high too, and a lovely diving effort from Randiv who runs to his left from long-on, and then dives full length
pushed down to long-on for another single
sharp offbreak, cut away from in front of middle, gets a single
short and wide, gets a single wide of point
full, wide of off, hit straight to point
Mis-hit for six! Manhas comes down the track, not quite to the pitch of the ball, gets a lot of height on it, and it falls six inches over the fence at cow corner. Jakati was there, but it eluded him
paddle sweep, but can't beat short fine
hit into the ground, and it lobs off to extra cover. The "knowledgeable" Chennai crowd think he is out. Don't think the knowledgeable ones come out for IPL
yorks him with a full delivery on the pads
turning into the pads, played straight to square leg
Badri makes a diving save at extra cover, but can't stop the single, Yuvraj's 1000th IPL run
How is this for timing? Yuvi comes down the track, hits it gently back at Raina, who gets a hand to it, but still the ball travels fast enough to bisect long-on and long-off
wants the sharp single to point but sent back by Manhas, and rightly so. Randiv was very alert
punched away, but straight to extra cover
driven to the left of extra cover, who dives and fields but can't prevent the single
full toss on the legs, and he misses out again, hit on the pad
appeal for bat-pad as Yuvraj comes down the track, is beaten in the flight, and sticks his pad out. The extra bounce hits him in the thigh, but there is no glove involved
floated across him, and riven square for a single
chipped away over extra cover, gets a couple
driven to long-off for a single
outside leg, and would have been a wide had Yuvraj not hit it, but he fins short fine
Badri makes a diving save at extra cover this time, but can't prevent the single
full, on the pads, pushes it down to long-on
misfielded by Badri at extra cover - it was hit hard at him - they take a single
this one pitches middle and leg, and hurries onto him, worked away for a single
full, around off, hit back to Raina
length ball, around off, driven for one to sweeper-cover
the straighter one, Manhas turns the bat face early, gets a leading edge that falls safe of extra cover
full toss, hit straight to extra cover
half-volley outside off, driven with an open face for a single
just short of driving length, leg line, turning away, defended
some drift on this offbreak, making him play away from the body, Manhas does well, and gets a single to point
full on the pads, nicely played down to long-on for one
Wicket-maiden! Manhas defends this offbreak to point
smart bowling, floated outside off, Manhas goes for the drive, this one doesn't turn, goes straight on, beating the outside edge
another carrom ball, gets a leading edge, back to the bowler on the bounce

bowled by an offspinner around his legs! Four down, all bowled! And what a delivery. Uthappa has not picked the carrom ball, and looks to paddle this. It's full, pitches leg, Uthappa is inside the line, and then turns away, hitting the stumps. Had it not turned away, Uthappa would have been safe. He can't believe the death rattle
tossed up wider outside off, defended to cover
full delivery, played to straightish midwicket
angled across him, and left alone

And the stumps are out third time! Again the slowness of the track perhaps. An action replay of Mishra's dismissal. He looks to run a back-of-a-length delivery down to third man and gets an underside edge into the stumps
Incredible shot! Pandey pulls this off the front off, with the back leg way up in the air, over midwicket. Won't do this to a sharp bouncer, though
slower ball, Pandey is way early into this shot, and gets a thick edge fine of third man for four
steered to third man for one
Beamer! Dhoni apologises immediately. He knows this one was dangerous. Morkel apologises both to the batsman and the umpire. They take a bye too
and he gets off the mark with a risky single, hit straight to mid-off, and diving into his crease. Anyway the stumps were not hit

Wet ball? Who cares? Arm ball cleans Ryder up, and Ashwin is charged up. This one pitches just outside off, Ryder goes back and plays for the offbreak, but it hurries along with the angle and takes the middle stump

Jisssy! This is how you play 'em. Lovely lovely straight hit. Comes down the track, covers the turn, and lofts him six feet to the right of sight screen. And what's more? The ball has been hit into wet floor behind the sight screen. Don't know where the water came from, but Chennai will surely not like this
slogged away, the natural shot off offspin, but there is deep midwicket and deep square leg waiting, and this one bounces in front of deep midwicket
nicely bowled, around off, turning in, defended
more turn, this time he pushes it past point for one
sharp offbreak, pitches outside leg and rips across him. No edge
fuller, but still not driving length, Pandey stays back and defends it to midwicket
Pandey gets a bouncer as welcome, ducks under it

Morkel has his man. Played on by Mishra. Short of a length, outside off, Mishra looks to run this down to third man, but the ball doesn't come on, and the slowness takes the inside edge onto the stumps
pulls this from half way down the pitch. Morkel saw him coming, dropped it short, but Mishra went ahead with the shot and beat midwicket
half-volley on the pads, clipped away over the infield, but Randiv does good work from deep square to keep them down to two
slower short delivery, Ryder rolls his wrists on this pull, and takes a single to deep backward square
half-volley on the pads, but Ryder is too early into it, and gets a leading edge all along the ground for one
Too good! Too good to take the edge. Angled in towards Ryder, back of a length, around off, making him play, then leaving him, but moves too much to take the edge
this is a better bouncer, more towards his face, and quicker, and hence the mis-hit on the pull, but he clears mid-on. Will Ryder have the Anzac luck that Hussey had?
lovely swivel-pull, not quite what you will call a sharp bouncer, and he pulls it with one leg in the air, over square leg
this one is sharper, beats Mishra for the pace as he looks to work it off the hip. It hits him on the hip, and concedes the leg-bye
Goes hard at a shortish delivery, doesn't quite come on, and he ends up hitting it down the ground. The mid-off is very wide and allows him the single
swinging away from a shortish length, beats his attempt at the cut. No feet from Mishra
takes the attack to Morkel, charging at him and chipping him over cover. Not the best of connections, but clears the infield
left alone outside off this time

Huge appeal, but neither Mohnish nor Aleem Dar thinks it is out. Full, and wide, Mohnish drives outside the line, misses, Dhoni goes up right away for the inside edge, but it seems to be another superb call from Dar. Morkel lets Mohnish know what he thinks of it, and it doesn't seem too complimentary
left alone outside off, good bounce, chest-high to Dhoni
shapes in to Ryder off a length, gets a leg bye
